newsitem.title: USA: Cremated human remains found in California lockers.
newsitem.headline: Cremated human remains found in California lockers.

text.p: Authorities on Friday said they made a macabre discovery at a California storage facility -- hundreds of boxes of cremated human remains.
Many of the boxes had name tags attached, identifying the cremated people inside, according to Contra Costa County Sheriff's Department Lt. Rick Weckel.
Investigators said they were baffled by what they found at the public storage facility in Discovery Bay, about 45 miles (72 km) east of San Francisco.
"We're leaving them in there for now," Weckel said of the boxes. "But we have people watching them so they're not disturbed until we know what we have."

KCBS radio in San Francisco reported that more than 2,000 boxes of cremated human remains were found in the lockers. They were stored there by a company that was hired to spread the ashes over local mountains and rivers, news reports said.
Authorities would only confirm the discovery of hundreds of boxes, and they would not name the company involved.
"It's a very sensitive issue," Weckel said. "We first need to determine what occurred."
